'''Allied Region''' was a term used to designate semi-independent regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that were part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later galactic governments but enjoyed a high level of autonomy.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

There were several definitions that marked these regions as separate entities: domination by a single species; astrographical feature (eg. a [[nebula/Legends|nebula]]); shared culture or history; or common government.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The status of Allied Region was traditionally given to small regions whose worlds had created unified interstellar empires long before their discovery by the Galactic Republic. These territories were absorbed into the Republic freely or by force of arms during its expansion. The [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] ruling these territories who accepted to join the Republic instead of fighting were given the titles of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. Over time, most of the Allied Regions were reorganized or divided in Republic [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. The [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] eventually abolished the titles the Moffs and Grand Moffs.<ref name="TEA" />

A millennia later, very few Allied Regions remained after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Some had managed to hold onto their meager powers, such as the [[Ollonir Boundaries]] and the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]]. These regions became ''de facto'' [[Imperial client state]]s. Most of these territories were later given a proper Allied Region status under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="TEA" />
